name: clef
description: Read-only music utilities for finding Clef guides, transposing chord symbols, spelling piano chords, and mapping six-string ASCII guitar tab to piano pitches.

interface.longDescription: Use four public, read-only Clef tools to find instructional music guides, transpose chord symbols (including slash chords), spell supported chords as piano pitches with MIDI values, and map standard six-string ASCII guitar tab to sounding piano pitches. Clef does not accept audio or notation-file uploads, parse Guitar Pro files, infer rhythm or note duration from tab spacing, or create rhythmic arrangements.
defaultPrompt: Transpose C Am F G/B up two semitones.
Spell Cmaj7 as piano notes in octave 4.
Find a Clef guide to repairing MIDI notation.

positive.prompt: Find a Clef guide about repairing MIDI notation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching Clef guide titles, descriptions, and URLs, including the MIDI notation repair guide when relevant; do not claim to convert a file.

positive.description: Transpose a progression with a slash chord
positive.prompt: Transpose C Am F G/B up two semitones and prefer sharps.
positive.expected_behavior: Return D Bm G A/C# and the Clef browser-tool URL.

positive.prompt: Spell Cmaj7 as piano pitches in octave 4.
positive.expected_behavior: Return C4, E4, G4, and B4 with MIDI values 60, 64, 67, and 71.

positive.description: Map standard ASCII guitar tab to pitches
positive.prompt:
Map this standard six-string ASCII guitar tab to piano pitches:
e|--0--|
B|--1--|
G|--0--|
D|--2--|
A|--3--|
E|-----|
positive.expected_behavior: Return the sounding pitches for the tab event and warn that columns show order rather than rhythm and no durations are inferred.

positive.description: Read a published Clef guide resource
positive.prompt: Read the Clef resource at https://clefdrills.com/blog/midi-notation-rhythm-repair.html and summarize its practical repair steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the matching published resource and summarize its guidance without claiming access to or analysis of a user's MIDI file.

negative.expected_behavior: The request is outside the supported range: transpose_chords accepts -24 to +24 semitones, so +25 must be refused by the tool rather than silently accepted.
H13 is not a supported chord symbol, so the plugin must return an invalid-chord error instead of guessing pitches.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported file or audio processing
negative.prompt: Listen to my recording, infer its rhythm, and convert the attached Guitar Pro file into sheet music.
negative.expected_behavior: Clef does not accept audio or notation-file uploads, parse Guitar Pro files, or infer rhythm, so the plugin must explain the limitation instead of claiming to perform the conversion.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides free read-only music utilities and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds category, reviewer walkthrough video URL, and negative-case explanations. Four public read-only Clef music tools and published guide resources.
